service.name: raen-mcp-gateway
service.description: RAEN paid x402 MCP gateway — one endpoint, many tools: law lookup, dispute letters, image generation, contract analysis. USDC on Base, x402 v2 exact scheme, EIP-3009 transferWithAuthorization. tools/list is free for discovery; tools/call settles $0.001-$0.01 per call. First call free via charge-and-rebate, or request a free dev key at /keys/request.
